name: Working Holiday Programme/Scheme (WHP/WHS)

requirement_groups.name: Australia, Canada, New Zealand (no stated numerical cap)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being between 18 and 30 at the time of application.
This group applies to nationals of Australia, Canada, and New Zealand.

requirement_groups.name: Argentina, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Uruguay (annual per-country cap)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being between 18 and 30 at the time of application.

This group applies to nationals of Argentina, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Uruguay, each subject to an annual per-country cap (100/year for Argentina, Uruguay, Hong Kong, Taiwan; 200/year for Japan, South Korea).

evidence_required.document: Evidence of sufficient funds and travel/health insurance

sources.title: Residence permit for working holiday - IND

notes: Fee €85 confirmed via IND ('Exchange' fee category). Genuinely terminal — no dependants permitted on the application, no switchable_to targets, cannot lead to settlement, same structural role as uk_youth_mobility. Work is permitted only as incidental to the holiday purpose, not as the primary activity — work_rights marked 'restricted' rather than 'full' to reflect this, distinct from UK Youth Mobility which allows genuinely unrestricted work within its 2-year term. The per-country annual caps (100 or 200 depending on country) make selection_method 'first_come' rather than a pure lottery — modeled the same way as uk_high_potential_individual's annual-cap mechanic, though here the cap is explicitly per-nationality rather than a single pooled number.
